title: Hardware placement integration
root_cause: Hardware routing and execution placement exist but are not obligatorily attached to every governed agent run.
source_requirement: Carry one exact placement decision, reserve, benchmark freshness, fallback, and outcome through governed execution.
implementation_steps: Resolve placement from attachment requirements and live inventory.
Record actual outcome and release reserve.
focused_tests: Placement compatibility and reserve lifecycle tests.
affected_tests: Agent runtime, resource lifecycle, and provider gateway tests.
evidence_required: Exact placement/reserve/outcome receipt and cleanup proof.
rollback: Disable automatic placement and release any session-owned reserve.
acceptance_criteria: Every governed agent run has exactly one current placement decision.
Actual outcome and cleanup are receipted.
